title: Onvaca
description: Onvaca is a travel and hospitality booking platform built around one idea: on home anywhere, on home everywhere. I created its full brand identity, from the logo and brand foundations to stationery, merchandise, campaign visuals, social media, website and mobile app designs.
challenge: A booking platform lives in a crowded market of familiar names. Onvaca needed an identity that feels warm and welcoming rather than transactional, a brand about belonging anywhere, while staying systematic enough to run across print, merchandise, billboards, social media and digital products.
solution: I built the Onvaca mark from three parts: the word ON, a location pin, and a route line, a simple symbol for finding your place anywhere. The identity uses a fresh cyan palette with clean typography, a repeating ON pattern, and photography-led layouts. I documented everything in a brand book: foundations, logo construction and usage rules, colour and typography, stationery and email signatures, magazine and brochure designs, campaign visuals, merchandise, and the website and mobile application.
results: A complete, documented brand world for Onvaca: logo system with usage rules, colour and typography, ON pattern, stationery, print and magazine designs, merchandise, social media templates, and website and mobile app designs, all speaking one welcoming language.
